Website Pages We envisage approximately 6–8 pages or templates: Homepage – Dramatic visual introduction, featured events and clear booking options. We will supply examples of our Cloaked Table branding, website mock-ups and existing event photography. Budget and Timescale Our target budget is £800–£1,500 for the initial website. We are looking for a fixed-price quotation and a realistic delivery timescale. We would prefer WordPress or Wix but are open to recommendations. What to Include in Your Proposal Please provide: Examples of websites you have previously designed. Your recommended platform and reasons for choosing it.
